blocks.content: The notification policy tree controls where alert notifications are delivered. This exploration helps you see how the concepts you just learned — contact points, policies, and routing — appear in the Grafana UI.
To view notification policies, complete the following steps:
In Grafana Cloud, navigate to **Alerts & IRM > Alerting > Notification policies**.
You should see the notification policy tree. At the top is the **Default policy** — the root of the tree that catches all alerts not matched by child policies.
In the next milestone, you'll explore the default policy and how child policies work.
